passkeys.title: Face ID & passkeys
passkeys.body: Sign in with your face, fingerprint, or device PIN instead of typing a password. Your device keeps the key and never shares it — add one per device you climb with.
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this account yet. Your password still works as usual.
